capabilities: veil text in the Markdown editor and Reading view with alternate-script glyphs
toggle the veil and cycle scripts via commands and a ribbon icon
peek at selected text to reveal it briefly
keep some whole-word anchors visible at a configurable cadence
leave the stored Markdown source untouched
disambiguation: Not encryption or access control; it only slows casual visual reading and the author lists what it does not protect against.
extras: The Obsidian plugin is one surface of a larger project that also ships a browser extension and a tmux plugin sharing the same transformation core; it is built from source (npm run package:obsidian) rather than installed from a store. Katakana, Hiragana, and Gregg packs are explicitly experimental, and the Gregg renderer is not intended for transcription or archival shorthand. Maintenance is optionally supported via Ko-fi without unlocking features.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make on-screen note text harder to read for someone glancing at your screen while keeping it readable to you.
summary: Shoulder-surfing filter that renders editor and Reading-view text in alternate scripts such as Greek or Katakana without changing the Markdown source.
